(B) The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Rent Agreement as per the
terms and conditions of this Third Amendment.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
June, 2023 (Effective Date").

1.

The Third Amendment shall come into force on

2.

Pursuant to Clause 1.2 of the Rent Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to further
extend the term of the Rent Agreement for a period of one (3) years commencing from the
Effective Date and ending on 31st May, 2026 ("Extended Term").

3.

The Parties agree that the monthly rent of the Rented Premises is hereby increased by
twenty-five percent (25%). Accordingly, the monthly rent payable by the Tenant to the
Landlord for the Rented Premises during the Extended Term shall be Rs. 468,750 (Rupees
Four Hundred Sixty-Eight Thousand Seven Hundred Fifty) per month inclusive of all
applicable taxes and maintenance charges ("Monthly Rent"). Now Monthly Rent is
Rs.1 87.5 Per Sq. Ft. For the avoidance of doubt, the next rental increment of 25% shall be
applicable with effect from OlS June 2026.

4.

This Third Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Rent Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Rent Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and
shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this Third Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Rent Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Rent Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this Third Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7

This Third Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Third Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
